item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a 2024 source showing Srettha personally ordered or tightened nuclear custody, transport, reactor safety, or emergency-response controls. I also did not find evidence of a nuclear incident, loss of control, or safety breakdown in Thailand during his tenure. So the best-supported reading is: Thailand showed a functioning and externally reviewed nuclear-security framework in 2024, with some improvements still recommended, but there is no direct ruler-specific proof of a major new safety or command-and-control initiative.","evidence":[{"title":"IAEA Mission to Thailand Finds a Robust Framework for Nuclear Security Arrangements, Encourages Improvements","publisher":"International Atomic Energy Agency","date":"September 13, 2024","url":"https://www.iaea.org/newscenter/pressreleases/iaea-mission-to-thailand-finds-a-robust-framework-for-nuclear-security-arrangements-encourages-improvements","summary":"Strong positive evidence for 1B.3.
